 California General Election 2026: Riverside County Results
 We’re tracking races across Riverside County, including local results for state and federal elections. Initial results are expected shortly after 8 p.m.
 By Alicia Ramirez 
 ● 
 Elections 
 ● 
 November 3, 2026 
 We’re tracking races across Riverside County, including local results for state and federal elections. Statewide results can be found here .

 Email 
 Initial results are expected shortly after 8 p.m. when polls across the state close. The data on this page will update as results come in from the Riverside County Registrar of Voters (ROV).
 Elizabeth Florer, public information officer for the ROV, said the first set of results are expected to be posted around 8:20 p.m. These results will include vote-by-mail and unscanned vote center ballots received prior to Election Day.
 The second set of results are expected around 9 p.m. and will include vote-by-mail ballots processed after 8 p.m. and any vote center ballots received prior to 8 p.m. Subsequent updates will continue to be posted every hour until approximately 3 a.m.
 Eligible ballots include all verified vote-by-mail ballots dropped off on Election Day, conditional voter registration ballots and any vote-by-mail ballot delivered by the United States Postal Service postmarked on or before Election Day and delivered to the ROV’s office by November 10.
 Watch live as election workers process and count ballots 
 A note about deadlines and results: While polls are set to close at 8 p.m., vote centers with lines will remain open until the last person in line by 8 p.m. has voted. Additionally, mail-in, provisional and conditional ballots will continue to be accepted, processed and counted for several days following Election Day. The Riverside County Registrar of Voters has 30 days to certify results of the election.
